fixture_name: Cloverleaf-to-urban interchange conversion — INT preliminary design (Wikimedia PD geometry)
subject: judge-baseline

justifications.substance: Shortened CD-road weave carrying a recorded 1,100 pcu/h design-year peak flow is a substantive preliminary-design safety issue with a credible sideswipe/rear-end mechanism, squarely within the audit stage's remit.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Pivotal claim rests on recorded GA-drawing geometry and recorded weave volume plus a verbatim EV-IN-015 quote of the PIARC Appendix 1 junction prompts that directly supports applying those checks now.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly framed as a safety_concern under the PIARC-derived INT baseline at preliminary design, keeping safety concerns distinct from compliance questions; HSM/IHSDM appear only as optional analytical aids, not as misapplied normative requirements.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Specific and staged: apply named §10.2 prompts to the identified weave, run HSM Part C / IHSDM evaluation, then lengthen the section or add ramp metering conditional on findings — all viable at preliminary design.
justifications.vru_coverage: VRUs explicitly considered and scoped out on recorded grounds (grade-separated shared-use paths), matching the not-applicable-but-acknowledged case.

justifications.substance: Uncontrolled free-flow ramp-terminal crossings of retained shared-use paths are a substantive VRU safety hazard squarely addressable at preliminary design, matching the int:preliminary-design stage where crossing provision can still be designed in.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Pivotal claim is anchored by verbatim quotes from EV-IN-016 (pedestrian/cyclist provision especially at junctions) and EV-IN-005 (all road users / VRU needs), with the layout and objective conditions drawn from recorded input facts stated in the scenario.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly filed as a safety_concern under the PIARC-derived international baseline, using the checklist prompts as the audit reference rather than asserting legal non-compliance, keeping safety and compliance categories distinct.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Recommendation is specific and viable: names the thematic-audit requirement, Walkability Checklist and CQSI tools, and prescribes signalised or grade-separated crossings at both retained loop-ramp terminals including the northern loop-ramp path crossing.
justifications.vru_coverage: Pedestrians and cyclists are the explicit focus with their exposure at ramp-terminal crossings fully analysed, so VRU coverage is complete rather than merely acknowledged.
